title: OpenAI announces ChatGPT Wallet, which lets its dots AI agents make purchases on behalf of users, available to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US who are over 18 (Ashley Capoot/CNBC)
summary: Ashley Capoot / CNBC: OpenAI announces ChatGPT Wallet, which lets its dots AI agents make purchases on behalf of users, available to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US who are over 18 — OpenAI on Friday announced ChatGPT Wallet, a new payment feature that enables its “dots” artificial intelligence agents to make purchases on behalf of users.
